relationships.subject: hinokitiol
relationships.evidence_quote: In LPS/ATP-stimulated BV2 cells, HIK promoted Nrf2 nuclear accumulation and HO-1 expression, reduced ROS accumulation, and attenuated inflammasome- and pyroptosis-associated markers.

relationships.subject: hinokitiol
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced spinal microglial activation, and decreased markers associated with NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptotic signaling

relationships.subject: ML385
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological Nrf2 inhibition with ML385 partially weakened the effects of HIK
